stemMarkdown: If 27 workers can complete a job in 11 days, how many days will 30 workers take to complete the same job, working at the same rate? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The job needs $27 \times 11 = 297$ worker-days. With 30 workers that takes $\dfrac{297}{30} = 9.9$ days. Workers and days vary inversely.
